run: PRO-72 merged run (base, classification, profile in one session)

name.basis: firm site; one brand since 2003 (the management company is Creandum AB, the fund advisers Creandum III/IV/V Advisor AB and Creandum Fund Manager AB, decisions.md ruling 1)

icon_url.basis: the site's 256x256 favicon (ICO container holding one PNG member, the firm's green mark on transparency), extracted to sources/site/favicon-256.png and normalised by scripts/fetch-investor-icon.ts on 2026-09-04 with Erik's ingest approval: synthesized white plate behind the bare glyph (source 86% transparent), keyline already met (box 73%, radius 77%), contrast 7.5:1; uploaded to the Icon Images bucket

founding_year.basis: the firm's own press releases (Wayback): formed autumn 2002 by the Sixth Swedish National Pension Fund and Skandia Liv, first closing and CEO appointment 2003-02-21, Staffan Helgesson announced as Managing Partner 2003-03-26; the firm's own 2016 post dates its inception to 2003

history.value: Creandum was founded in Stockholm in 2003 with a SEK 300M Nordic seed fund. It was the first venture investor in Spotify and iZettle and an early backer of Klarna, Trade Republic, Depop and Lovable. Today it is a pan-European firm with offices in Stockholm, Berlin, London and San Francisco, and it closed its seventh fund at $542M in 2024.
history.basis: anchors and first close per the 2003 press releases; SEK 300M fund size per the 2004-03-02 press; offices per the live team CMS (Stockholm, Berlin, London, San Francisco); 'first venture capital investor in Spotify and iZettle' per the firm's own 2019 Creandum V post; Klarna (2016 secondary, ruling 5), Trade Republic, Depop and Lovable are ledger-verified members. Rewritten to the reader-facing shape (PRO-147, 2026-09-24). The old thesis was the site's first-person hero line; the rewrite follows the site's own meta description ('From Seed to IPO and beyond') and investment_scope. Creandum VII's size is in the funds list.

investment_concept.value: “We back the companies of tomorrow before it's obvious.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from its homepage headline (h1) and title tag, read 2026-09-26; sentence case, straight quotes and a closing period are the only edits. PRO-147: the thesis is the firm's own crisp statement (Erik, 2026-09-26). Published inside quotation marks, as the firm's own words (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_stage.basis: entry stages on the 177-row base after classification: Seed 90, Series A 67, Growth 17, Pre-Seed 3; the firm's own framing is 'Seed and Series A' (2019 Creandum V post: 'the best returns are generated at Seed and Series A') with follow-on capital through the Select funds and the Trade Republic SPV (ruling 3), which carry the Growth entries (Klarna 2016, Bolt, Gopuff, Navan, Trade Republic)

investment_geo.basis: hq_country on the classified base: 152 of 177 rows in Europe (SE 48, DE 34, GB 24, DK 11, FI 9, NO 5, FR 5, ES 3, others), US 20, CA 2, IL/CL/TR 1 each; offices Stockholm, Berlin, London and San Francisco (team CMS); the firm's own 2016 post: 'invest across Europe but with a particular focus on the Nordic region'

investment_scope.basis: focus from the firm's own site sector tags on 257 base rows, crosswalked to data/taxonomy/focus.json (crosswalk in config.json), published above 12 companies. Scope type is the curated judgement carried in investor.json.

investment_range.basis: Median: the firm's own entry announcements (stories 2009-2024 and Wayback news 2003-2014) that state a round size: 47 rounds, median $6.7M, p25 $3.2M, p75 $13.0M, p90 $17.2M (EUR at 1.15, SEK at 0.10 for the proxy; the rounds are co-invested, so this is a round-size proxy for check size, published as $7M). Form D issuer histories cover only the 7 US-incorporated members and were not used. | Lower limit: the smallest announced entry rounds are seed rounds of $0.7M-2M (13th Lab $700K 2012, Klaus $1.9M 2019, Taxfix EUR 2M 2017); press guides quote $1M-10M checks (Superscout); published as $1M. | Upper limit: the largest documented single-company commitment is the Trade Republic SPV, $22,254,795 sold to US investors (Form D 2022q2, first sale 2021-05-18) plus its (E) twin; the firm calls the undisclosed EquiLibre Series A (Jul 2026) 'the largest single investment it has ever made in one go' (TechCrunch 2026-06-30, EU-Startups 2026-07); published as $25M

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first: the names a general reader would recognise first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24). Each is tied to its portfolio row by `slugs`; names read as a reader knows them, without legal suffixes (COLLECTION.md §8). Previously listed (10): Spotify, Klarna, iZettle, Trade Republic, Lovable, Depop, Vivino, Kahoot!, Bolt, Pleo.

aum.basis: Bottom and top: the sworn Form ADV Section 7.B(1) gross asset values of the eight live Creandum vehicles as of the 2026-03 annual amendments of the firm's exempt reporting advisers (IAPD PDFs parsed 2026-09-04, scratch/adv-7b-funds.json): Creandum V, L.P. $2,331,024,786 (CRD 306543), Creandum IV, L.P. $596,092,166 (308519), Creandum III, L.P. $354,909,919 (308517), and under Creandum Fund Manager AB (330446) Creandum VII (D) AB $487,884,493, Creandum VI (D) AB $458,587,296, Select Fund II (D) AB $131,900,356, Select Fund I (D) AB $108,863,333, SPV TR (D) AB $98,867,813 = $4,568,130,162. Exempt reporting advisers file no Item 5.F RAUM, so 7.B gross asset value is the sworn substitute (decisions.md ruling 9); it is fair value of fund assets, not commitments, and excludes the liquidated Creandum I and II and Creandum VIII (Form D 2026-06-30, indefinite, $0 sold). Press quotes '$2B AUM' (Superscout 2025) and the firm's own 'over $750 million under management' (2019), both below the sworn composite, so no higher top is published

sources.note: The firm's own 2024-06-08 'Creandum Fund VII' post (image-led body); size in press: EUR 500M (Vestbee, ArcticStartup 2024-06; Axios 2024-06-03).
Form D 2024q1 (accession 0002011558-24-000001): indefinite offering, $0 sold at first filing; the ADV 7.B roster carries Creandum VII (D) AB at $487.9M gross asset value (2026-03).
The firm's own 2022-02-28 post: 'half a billion' for early founders; press EUR 448M / $500M (EU-Startups, tech.eu 2022-03-01).
Form D 2022q2 (accession 0001914473-22-000001): $244,085,410 sold to US investors, the US tranche of the (D)/(E) pair, not the fund size.
The firm's own 2019-06-23 post: '$300 million at a heavily oversubscribed first and final close'.
Form D 2019q4 (accession 0001796391-19-000001, Guernsey L.P.): $74,776,819 sold, the US tranche.
The firm's own 2016-01-31 post: 'At 180 MEUR the fund ... reached the hard cap in one first and final closing'. EUR 180M @ ECB 2016-01-29 (EUR/USD 1.092) = $196.6M.

The firm's own news 2013-05-07 (Wayback, /news/creandum-raises-the-largest-technology-venture-capital-fund-in-the-nordics-at-€135m): third fund closed at EUR 135M. EUR 135M @ ECB 2013-05-07 (EUR/USD 1.3107) = $176.9M.

The firm's own news index 2007-02-06 (Wayback /news.html): 'Creandum closes its second fund on hard cap SEK 750 million (107 MUSD)'; the 2013 news calls it 'the previous EUR 80M Creandum fund raised in 2007'. SEK 750M @ ECB 2007-02-06 (SEK/EUR 9.1365, EUR/USD 1.2955) = $106.3M.

The firm's own press 2003-03-26 (Wayback /press_030326_en.html): 'up to SEK 400 million', SEK 200M committed at first close by AP6 and Skandia Liv; the 2004-03-02 press states 'Creandum is a 300 million SEK venture capital fund'. SEK 300M @ ECB 2004-03-02 (SEK/EUR 9.2481, EUR/USD 1.2402) = $40.2M.

Form D 2021q1 (accession 0001012975-21-000140, first sale 2020-12-15, co-issuer Select Fund I (E) AB): $122,000,000 total offering across the (D)/(E) pair, $16,694,100 sold at filing (the US tranche). The ADV 7.B roster carries the (D) vehicle at $108.9M gross asset value (2026-03). Follow-on (select) fund for existing portfolio.

Form D 2022q2: $106,121,048 sold (first sale 2022-04-25; indefinite offering); the filed amount is the only size on record (PitchBook echoes it). The ADV 7.B roster carries the (D) vehicle at $131.9M gross asset value (2026-03).
Form D 2022q2: $22,254,795 sold (first sale 2021-05-18), a single-company vehicle for Trade Republic (decisions.md ruling 3); the ADV 7.B roster carries it at $98.9M gross asset value (2026-03).

funds.basis: ten vehicles 2003-2024 with sizes from the firm's own posts and press releases (I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII) converted at ECB reference rates on the announcement date (scripts/fx-convert.py, ruling 5), and from the Form D filed amounts where no press size exists (Select I total offering; Select II and SPV TR sold amounts, accession-verified). The (D) AB funds file the US tranche as 'sold', so Form D amounts are not fund sizes for V, VI and VII (ruling 9). Creandum VIII (D) AB is in market (Form D 2026-06-30, indefinite offering, $0 sold) with no published size and is not listed

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: Jakobsbergsgatan 18, Stockholm, Sweden (CREANDUM V ADVISOR AB, CRD 306543, Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-26). The firm's site lists San Francisco, CA; London, United Kingdom; Berlin, Germany; Stockholm, Sweden; the principal office is among them, so the site agrees. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
